note_en: 原来 announces a discovery: the speaker suddenly understands what was really going on, much like English "so it turns out...": 建国才恍然大悟，原来“稀饭”就是“粥” "only then did it dawn on Jianguo: xifan was just porridge all along." Note the pairing with 才 "only then," which stresses how long the confusion lasted. Don't confuse this 原来 with the adjective meaning "original, former" (原来的计划 "the original plan").

sentences.en: Accent jokes like these are hugely popular on Chinese social media. Mandarin spoken with a heavy local accent is often self-mockingly called "plastic Mandarin" by netizens, meaning the pronunciation is off-standard and sounds a bit "warped."
